title: Developer - DP Specialty
description: Use Pentaho Data Integration to build the star schemas and summary tables that cubes and domains sit on: a date dimension, dimensions with slowly changing history, fact and summary tables, and a scheduled load that refreshes the cube.

assistant.subject: preparing data for Pentaho analytics with Pentaho Data Integration (dimensional modeling, slowly changing dimensions, fact and summary tables, scheduled loads)
suggestions: How does Dimension lookup/update keep the history of a customer?
How do I name an aggregate table so Mondrian can use it?
How do I refresh a cube after a nightly load?

moduleSummaries.title: Getting Started
moduleSummaries.summary: How to get the most out of this guide, and the route from source data to a star schema an analyst can model.

moduleSummaries.title: Modeling the Star
moduleSummaries.summary: Dimensional modeling in practice: a date dimension, then dimensions that keep their history.

moduleSummaries.title: Loading Facts
moduleSummaries.summary: Load the fact table against its dimensions, then the summary tables that aggregate tables and dashboards read.

moduleSummaries.title: Automate and Publish
moduleSummaries.summary: Schedule the load on the Pentaho Server, and refresh the cube once new data arrives.

moduleSummaries.title: Capstone Project
moduleSummaries.summary: Build a sales mart from raw orders, schedule its load, and point a cube at it.
